title: Clinton River Canoe & Kayak
specs: Rediscover the scenic beauty of the Clinton River from a canoe or kayak.
Outdoor recreation opportunities in the Southeast Michigan area.
blurb: Clinton River Canoe & Kayak offers paddling adventures on the Clinton River using canoes or kayaks. The business is family owned and dedicated to providing outdoor recreation opportunities in Southeast Michigan. They participate in local community activities and aim to help kids connect with nature. The business operates seasonally through September 7, 2026.
